scripts.build: test -f ../swift-server/.build/release/slicc-server || (echo 'Error: slicc-server binary not found. Run: cd ../swift-server && swift build -c release' && exit 1) && swift build -c release && node assemble-app.mjs
scripts.format: swift format --in-place --parallel --recursive Sliccstart SliccstartTests SliccstartWidgets Package.swift
scripts.lint:format: swift format lint --strict --parallel --recursive Sliccstart SliccstartTests SliccstartWidgets Package.swift
